title: Sophisticated Backpacks: Advanced Crafting Upgrade
description: Adds an advanced Sophisticated Backpacks crafting upgrade that can craft using items inside nested backpacks.
body:
# Sophisticated Backpacks: Advanced Crafting

Adds an **Advanced Crafting Upgrade** for [Sophisticated Backpacks](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-backpacks), built for players who use nested backpack storage setups.

The upgrade works like the normal crafting upgrade, but can refill and craft using items stored inside backpacks that are accessible through Sophisticated Backpacks' inception-style nested storage behavior.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3708ed5c4049ac3a1bf9d9440acc7788a77840d0.png)

## Features

- Adds a new **Advanced Crafting Upgrade**
- Craft directly from items inside nested backpacks
- JEI recipe transfer support for nested backpack contents
- Optional toggle to only pull from **memorized backpack slots**
- Works naturally with Sophisticated Backpacks' existing crafting upgrade UI
- Designed for compact, organized backpack-based crafting setups

## Slot Memory Integration

The advanced upgrade can optionally restrict nested crafting pulls to backpack slots selected with Sophisticated Backpacks' slot memory feature.

This is useful if you only want crafting to pull from specific nested backpacks, such as a materials backpack, block backpack, or mob drops backpack, while ignoring other nested storage.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge
- Sophisticated Backpacks
- Sophisticated Core
- JEI is optional, but supported

## Notes

This mod is an addon for Sophisticated Backpacks and is intended to feel like a small extension of the original mod rather than a separate crafting system.
